title.en: Kepler ellipse with equal-time swept areas

summary: Advance a body nonuniformly around an ellipse and compare sectors swept in equal time intervals.
objective: Build a Kepler ellipse with the primary at one focus, a time scrubber and equal-time swept-area sectors.
intent_signals: Build a Kepler ellipse with the primary at one focus, a time scrubber and equal-time swept-area sectors.
Advance a body nonuniformly around an ellipse and compare sectors swept in equal time intervals.
example_prompts: Build a Kepler ellipse with the primary at one focus, a time scrubber and equal-time swept-area sectors.
Create an explorable 3D explanation of Kepler orbit with swept sectors.
negative_signals: No current planetary positions, perturbations, relativity, n-body interaction or ephemeris accuracy.
not_for: No current planetary positions, perturbations, relativity, n-body interaction or ephemeris accuracy.

entities.name: Primary and orbit
entities.guidance: Place the primary marker at the focus, not ellipse center; draw major axis, focus offset and labeled periapsis/apoapsis.

entities.name: Orbiting body
entities.guidance: Use a visible body marker with disclosed size exaggeration; preserve distance coordinates even when body radius is enlarged for selection.

entities.name: Swept sectors
entities.guidance: Shade sectors formed by the focus and positions at equal time increments, with numeric areas computed from the orbital model.

state_contract.model: Ideal bound two-body relative orbit in a plane: a>0 in meters, gravitational parameter mu>0 in m^3/s^2, time in seconds and 0<=e<=0.85. Mean anomaly M=M0+sqrt(mu/a^3)*t; solve E-e*sin(E)=M, then x=a*(cos(E)-e), y=a*sqrt(1-e*e)*sin(E).
state_contract.authority: Orbital elements and model time determine analytic positions through a bounded Kepler-equation solve; display orbit sampling does not determine speed.
actions: Change eccentricity or semimajor axis, explicitly restarting the initial condition.
Compare equal-duration sectors near periapsis and apoapsis.

invariants: Equal model-time intervals sweep equal areas within solver and quadrature tolerance.
The primary stays at a focus; e=0 reduces to a circle with uniform angular motion.
Computed Kepler residual remains below a declared tolerance; nonconvergence is reported.
motion_guidance: Use safeguarded iteration or bracketed fallback for eccentric anomaly; never assume uniform true-anomaly advancement.
Keep one model clock and unwrap phase consistently across complete revolutions.
known_limits: No current planetary positions, perturbations, relativity, n-body interaction or ephemeris accuracy.
The primary is a focus in relative coordinates; a barycentric two-body display requires a separate mass-ratio transform.
Curated recipe only; no runtime scene or rendered behavior has been verified for this record.

claims.statement: Bound Keplerian planetary orbits are ellipses with the Sun at a focus and sweep equal areas in equal times.
claims.scope: Ideal Kepler model; current solar-system observations are not represented.

object_craft.structure: Place the primary marker at the focus, not ellipse center; draw major axis, focus offset and labeled periapsis/apoapsis.
object_craft.material: Dark neutral background with restrained body finishes and legible sector boundaries; glow is decorative and not used to infer luminosity.

physical_contract.scope: Analytic planar Kepler orbit evaluated via Kepler equation.
colliders: No rigid-body colliders; any boundary is part of the declared mathematical model.
driving: Two-body orbital relation with declared gravitational parameter.
contact: No collision or impact response is supplied by this field model.
physical_contract.timestep: Evaluate the declared analytic state at paused or running model time; rendering never advances a second model.
checks: Check periapsis a*(1-e) and apoapsis a*(1+e).
